data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE**, is picked to [Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** An **ASPECT WARRIORS** or **AVATAR OF KHAINE** unit of yours in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the enemy unit.

**Effect:** Every model in the enemy unit takes a [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape), with -1 to each test if that unit is [Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock).
